answer: Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. An operator running 189 keys thus pays for 189 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the sparrow quota and the voyage admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the ripple ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
